mainText: Hello, Verona! At 9 AM, here is today's balanced dish. It is currently 67 degrees under overcast skies, with a real-feel of 69 degrees, making it a comfortable morning for a walk along the Military Ridge State Trail.

In city news, Verona is promoting sustainable living through several initiatives. Apartment residents can now drop off food scraps at the Badger Prairie Food Scrap Stop on East Verona Avenue. Additionally, the city is enhancing its green credentials by installing anti-idling technology on its new ambulance, utilizing hybrid police vehicles, and continuing to earn recognition as a bicycle-friendly community.

We have a wonderful lineup of events coming up. This Sunday, July 19th, you can enjoy live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard and Lake Louie, or explore the Mount Horeb Art Fair. Looking ahead in Verona, the popular Verona Downtown Farmer's Market returns next Wednesday, July 22nd, at Hometown Junction Park.

In the weekly police recap, officers responded to a vehicle versus bicycle crash on Friday, July 10th, at Old PB and Whalen Road. A bicyclist sustained minor injuries, and a driver was cited for failing to yield the right of way.

For your sweet treat of the day, Culver's of Verona is currently closed but will open at 10 AM today serving up their delicious Turtle flavor. If you are planning ahead, tomorrow's flavor will be Dark Chocolate PB Crunch.
